name: Ulrich Herberg, Ph.D.
headline: GM of Software Engineering Payments & Shipping at eBay Germany
summary:
- GM of the new eBay development center in Berlin, started a new organization from scratch. Leading teams in the area of payments, compliance, identity, protections, and shipping.
- Former Chief Identity Architect at eBay: Leading eBay’s Identity organization on all related topics, including IAM, user management, 2FA (FIDO, TOTP), authentication and authorization (OAuth / OpenID Connect), PKI, TLS.
- Hands-on Cloud Expert: Lead the successful move of Yahoo's PCI credit card platform with $1bn revenue into the cloud (AWS).
- Recipient of two Critical Talent Awards, two President’s Awards and one Best Employee of the Year award.
- 14+ years of experience in full stack development: Java, micro services, Amazon AWS, Linux, MySQL, Android, JavaScript, and HTML.
- Standardization expert (13 IETF RFCs, former IETF Working Group chair), focus on routing, security in IoT / wireless mobile networks, and IPv6.
- Former researcher on IoT, Smart Grid communication, wireless sensor networks, and network security.
- 28 international conference and journal publications, 6 patents

positions.title: Sr. Director of Software Engineering
positions.description:
- GM of the new eBay development center in Berlin for Payments & Shipping, started a new organization from scratch and growing it to 70+ engineers.
- Leading teams in the area of payments, compliance, identity, protections, and shipping.

positions.title: Chief Identity Architect, Distinguished Engineer
positions.description:
- Executive level engineering leader
- Chief Identity Architect at eBay: IAM, user management, 2FA (FIDO, TOTP), authentication and authorization (OAuth / OpenID Connect)
- Responsible for architecture in major projects in Managed Payments spanning the whole organization of ~650 engineers
- Improving coding best practices and knowledge transfer for the entire organization and the wider eBay engineering community of thousands of engineers.

positions.title: Senior Principal Engineer
positions.description:
- Led architecture and hands-on migration of Yahoo's entire payments platform processing ~$1bn in transactions per year into AWS (ECS cluster, Fargate, Cloudformation, Docker, Java 17)
- Design and implementation of security solutions (mutual TLS, x.509, authorization, OAuth 2.0)

positions.title: Sr. Software Architect
positions.description:
- Principal architect and Engineering lead of the newly released Verifone App Marketplace coordinating with 10 teams in Verifone; awarded a President’s Award for this achievement. Marketplace attracted double digit million dollars contracts with customers across the world.
- Defining software architecture for innovative new payment solutions. Interaction with Android engineers, defining the APIs for mobile apps, and security architecture (OAuth 2.0, mutual TLS, X.509, PKI). Teaching security topics to 50+ engineers in Lunch&Learn sessions.
- Leading a team of back-end and front-end engineers, creating new flagship payment solution for Verifone.
- Hands-on implementation of back-end services using technologies such as Spring Boot, JPA, Hibernate, MySQL, RESTful APIs, Swagger. Hands-on AWS set-up with continuous deployment (EC2, S3, Route53, CodeDeploy, CodePipeline, IAM, RDS, VPC, etc.), Android implementation (MDM).

positions.title: Lead Architect
positions.description:
- Leading a team of senior developers (including iOS/Android), QA testers, system administrators in a fast-driven start-up-like Agile environment, defining technical road map, system architecture (security / scalability), and hiring decisions. Released a successful SaaS health-care software product (HIPAA).
- Hands-on software development of a full-stack distributed software solution, using Android, Java, HTML5, JavaScript, CSS, PHP, XML, MySQL, JSON, REST services, APIs, and Amazon AWS in the area of health care and wellness for seniors.
- Responsible for administrating AWS infrastructure.
- Overseeing automatic and manual QA testing, using Selenium Webdriver, Jenkins.

positions.title: 6lo Working Group Chair
positions.description: - Founded and led this Working Group as one of two chairs with over 100 participants on IPv6 over constrained link layers, such as IEEE 802.15.4, DECT-ULE, and Z-Wave.

positions.title: Member of Research Staff at Fujitsu Laboratories of America
positions.description:
- Awarded as “Best Employee of the year FY2013” by Fujitsu Labs of America, and received the “Fujitsu Labs President’s Award 2013“
- Completed standardization as main editor of major automated Demand Response standard OpenADR2.0b, and of Fujitsu’s principal AMI routing protocol as IETF RFC as the main editor
- Multiple papers published, and patents filed on IoT, wireless network and security topics.
- Lead of software development of Fujitsu’s OpenADR2.0 implementation, using Java EE (JAX-RS, Hibernate, RESTful), XML, XMPP, which received official certification by the OpenADR Alliance and made Fujitsu the first company in the world to get certification.
